name: print-social-happy-new-month-post-with-stacked-glowing-green-bars
title: 'Happy New Month!' post with tilted stacked neon-green wish bars
whatItIs: A portrait black post with a 'sprucegraphix' logo, white 'Happy' and green 'New Month!', and four slightly tilted rounded bars with green glowing outlines, each with a line icon (bulb, people, heart, award) and a wish (Exciting Opportunities, Positive Connections, Great Health, Abundant Success), the last filled solid green.
whatItMeans: Upbeat and modern; stacked glowing tags feel like notifications of good things coming.
techniques: Stack tilted bars like a pile of cards.
Fill the last item solid as a climax.
Pair each wish with a simple line icon.
Glow outlines in the accent colour.

vocabulary.definition: Overlapping offset panels suggesting a pile.
